description: Order-to-cash documents: sales orders and lines, customer PO references, outbound shipments and customer invoices and lines across the Portal gold tables, FileMaker bronze, the Sage mirror and Business Central. One object per source record; records of one business order are linked by stored keys (verified) or by number text (lead), never merged. Customer and Product are declared by catalog_parties; bc_finance links its ledger types to these documents.

object_types.description: A customer sales order, one object per source record (gold, FM order entry, Sage OE, BC). Records of one business order are joined by SalesOrder.same_record_as, never merged. BC deletes a sales order once it is shipped and invoiced: such an order is projected from the posted invoices (else shipments) that still name it (bindings that stand_for bc.sales_orders), one object per company and order number, never beside a BC order record of that number.

bindings.note: Rows with neither a source marker nor a Sage key (legacy silver ETL rows without custom_fields, Portal SOs later linked by fmId) stay gold_native_staging: their origin is not provable from the row.
FM rows the Portal bridge minted (id >= 900000, or whose gold twin says source gold-so-bridge) are gold_native_staging.

The order a posted invoice names (orderNumber) when no salesOrders record of that number is held in the company: BC deleted it once shipped and invoiced. The object is cited to the first-recorded such document; it carries the order number only (no order lines: BC serves none).

The order a posted shipment names (orderNumber) when no salesOrders record of that number is held in the company: BC deleted it once shipped and invoiced. The object is cited to the first-recorded such document; it carries the order number only (no order lines: BC serves none).

properties.name: order_number
properties.description: Canonical order key. Not immutable: gold order_number is rewritten to the BC document No. after drain; Sage ETL may store DSO-/MSO-<ordnumber> when the number is taken.

authority.note: BC is authority once drained (Portal rewrites order_number to the BC No.); differing numbers across sources are reported, never merged.

properties.name: customer_po
properties.description: Raw customer PO text as stored (can be a person's name, 'NA' or the Portal SO number). The customer_po identifier is derived only by the deterministic normalizer.

authority.note: FM custpocode and Sage ponumber are the originals; gold po_reference copies them (FM-ensure on create or when empty, Sage ETL by COALESCE) and BC externalDocumentNumber copies po_reference. Gold rows migrated by the legacy FM SQL (migrate-fm-to-portal.sql) may hold the PO only in custom_fields.custPoCode, so it is a carrier of this property too: a reader that looks only at po_reference cannot show the PO is absent. FM rows the Portal minted carry po_reference ?? order_number and are gold_native_staging (never authority; the CustomerPurchaseOrder binding excludes them).

properties.name: fm_reference
properties.description: FM order_entry.reference: free text that the legacy migration copied into po_reference; never a PO by itself.

properties.name: status
properties.description: Gold status, a free string (vocabulary in SALES_ORDER_STATUSES plus legacy 'Open' and FM status text from ETL). Other systems' statuses are separate properties: the vocabularies differ.

properties.name: fm_status
properties.description: FM order_entry status text.

properties.name: bc_status
properties.description: BC sales order status.

properties.name: sage_complete
properties.description: Sage OE COMPLETE flag as stored.

properties.name: order_date
properties.description: Business order date. Gold order_date defaults to row creation and FM-ensure never sets it, so gold_etl_from_fm and gold_native_staging values are not authority.

authority.note: BC orderDate is the Portal order_date pushed by the serializer, a downstream copy.

properties.name: required_date
properties.description: Customer required date (a planned date).

properties.name: currency
properties.description: Order currency. Gold currency defaults to CAD (the Sage ETL inserts 'CAD'); a blank BC currencyCode means BC local currency (Portal sends CAD as blank).

properties.name: subtotal
properties.description: Order amount excluding tax. A blank BC currencyCode = BC local currency.

sources.note: tax_basis: every writer sums line totals before tax (plx-customer-portal@fa46f2d: portal/src/lib/sales-order/service.ts:343 then tax added at :346; portal/src/lib/wms/ensure-sales-order-from-fm-oe.ts:350; portal/scripts/etl-sage-distribution-gold.mjs:1463-1469 with tax_amount 0).

properties.name: total_amount
properties.description: Order total. Gold total_amount is a Float (float-formatted text in the API); the Sage ETL writes total_amount = subtotal, so a gold/Sage difference can be tax, not an error.

sources.note: tax_basis by writer (plx-customer-portal@fa46f2d): the FM bridge writes the (discounted) subtotal without tax (portal/src/lib/wms/ensure-sales-order-from-fm-oe.ts:363) and the Sage ETL total_amount = subtotal with tax_amount 0 (portal/scripts/etl-sage-distribution-gold.mjs:1521, :1569); a Portal-entered order adds taxAmount (portal/src/lib/sales-order/service.ts:346, :853) but the FM bridge may later re-total it without tax, so gold_native_staging rows stay unknown.

authority.note: BC is authority for money (R1). Gold totals of FM-ensure rows are re-priced by the Portal and are not authority.

properties.name: fulfillment_mode
properties.description: MAKE (manufacturing) or DISTRIBUTE (buy-resale); drives SO vs DSO numbering.

properties.name: fm_id
properties.description: FM order_entry id; on the gold row it is the OE-to-SO bridge key.

properties.name: sage_ord_uniq
properties.description: Sage ORDUNIQ. On the gold row sageSourceOrdUniq is the raw orduniq; sageOrdUniq can carry a 'MAKE:' prefix.

properties.name: renumbered_to
properties.description: BC document No. the gold order was renumbered to after drain.

properties.name: fm_oe_number
properties.description: Earlier FM/Portal order number kept at BC renumbering.

properties.name: erp_code
properties.description: custom_fields.erpCode: the FM order_entry erpcode stamped on the gold order by both FM bridges (fm-oe-ensure, gold-so-bridge); the Portal searches it as one of an order's numbers when it matches a BC sales invoice's externalDocumentNumber (resolveSalesOrderFinanceMatchKeys). Declared here so plx.find searches the same key the SalesInvoice.bills link declares.

properties.name: source_quote_id
properties.description: custom_fields.sourceQuoteId: the Portal quote id convertAcceptedQuote stamps on the sales order it creates. The order-to-quote half of the commercial chain; absent on orders that were not converted from a Portal quote.

properties.name: source_quote_number
properties.description: custom_fields.sourceQuoteNumber: the quote number (QUO-<year>-NNNN) stamped with sourceQuoteId at conversion. Declared so plx.find reaches the order by the quote number a case names.

properties.name: fm_erp_code
properties.description: FM order_entry.erpcode: the order number FM itself carries (the Portal stamps it as custom_fields.erpCode on the gold order). Declared so plx.find reaches the FM order row by the number a case names.

object_types.description: A sales order line per source record. Gold line ids are not stable (draft edits and the Sage ETL delete and recreate lines), so a gold line is identified only within one capture.

bindings.note: Lines inherit their order header's lineage (SalesOrderLine.line_of).
Lines inherit their order header's lineage (SalesOrderLine.line_of).
Read only by nested navigation from the BC sales order; documentId is the parent id.

properties.name: ordered_quantity
properties.description: Ordered quantity. Gold uom is a free-text label (no conversion).

unit_unknown.reason: FM order_entry_item serves no unit column; the Portal reads FM order quantities as pieces (03 s4.8), which is not a served fact.

properties.name: unit_price
properties.description: Unit price in the order header's currency.

gold_etl_from_sage.reason: The Sage ETL stores the Sage line price (per the Sage order unit) next to the gold product's uom, so the line's uom is not the price's unit.

gold_etl_from_fm.reason: The FM O/E bridge stores a price-list price next to the FM or product uom (or a guessed ea/kg); no writer states the price per that uom.

sources.note: tax_basis: line prices feed the pre-tax subtotal; tax is added only on the order header (plx-customer-portal@fa46f2d: portal/src/lib/sales-order/service.ts:343-346).

properties.name: line_total
properties.description: Line amount (quantity x unit price) in the order header's currency. For gold_etl_from_sage lines the Sage ETL writes the open (ordered - shipped) quantity and its amount. For gold_etl_from_fm lines the FM bridge writes a Sage price-list price times the FM quantity, and nothing grounds that the price is per the unit the quantity counts (the line's unit_price denominator is unknown there), so the stored total may multiply two units: read it as the source states it, never re-derive it from quantity and unit price.

sources.note: tax_basis: as unit_price (total_price = unit_price x quantity; tax is added only on the header).

properties.name: uom
properties.description: Free-text unit label; not a conversion.

properties.name: line_source
properties.description: STOCK ships from a warehouse; MAKE is produced.

object_types.description: A customer PO reference as carried by one order record (identifier object). Object identity across carriers is (customer, normalized PO number) and only yields candidates: values are not unique and some are not POs.

bindings.note: Only FM-entered rows (id < PORTAL_OE_ID_BASE 900000). Rows the Portal minted from a gold SO store custpocode = po_reference ?? order_number (ensure-fm-oe-from-sales-order.ts:191-192 @b46934a): with no customer PO that is the SO number, so they never carry a customer-PO candidate; a real PO on them is already carried by gold po_reference.

properties.name: po_text
properties.description: Raw carrier text.

authority.note: FM custpocode and Sage ponumber are the originals; gold po_reference copies them (FM-ensure on create or when empty, Sage ETL by COALESCE) and BC externalDocumentNumber copies po_reference. FM rows the Portal minted (id >= 900000, custpocode = po_reference ?? order_number) are excluded by the binding, so the SO number is never a customer-PO candidate.

properties.name: po_number
properties.description: Normalized customer PO (customer_po normalizer); Portal itself compares by exact trimmed text.

authority.note: FM custpocode and Sage ponumber are the originals; gold po_reference copies them (FM-ensure on create or when empty, Sage ETL by COALESCE) and BC externalDocumentNumber copies po_reference. FM rows the Portal minted (id >= 900000, custpocode = po_reference ?? order_number) are excluded by the binding, so the SO number is never a customer-PO candidate.

properties.name: customer_ref
properties.description: The customer the order record holding this PO names, as that system writes it (Portal customer_id, FM idcust, Sage customer, BC customerNumber): the identity scope of the PO (identifiers.json customer_po identity_scope, each carrier's scope_field). A PO names an order only together with its customer; values of two systems are never compared.

authority.note: One value per record: each binding is one system's record, so two systems' customer values never meet on one object and are never compared (FM idcust, Sage customer, Portal customer_id and BC customerNumber are four scope spaces, identifiers.json customer_po carriers).

object_types.description: An outbound shipment per source record (gold WMS shipment, FM silver shipment, Sage OE shipment, BC posted sales shipment).

bindings.note: A gold shipment with an FM silver twin (same shipment_code) is the silver ETL's copy; the rest are WMS-created (gold_native_staging).
salesShipments has no query spec in the Workbench BC allowlist yet; number/orderNumber/customerNumber are the fields Portal's drain and BC API v2.0 use.

properties.name: shipment_number
properties.description: Shipment code (SH100000+ for Portal; FM codes via silver).

properties.name: bc_number
properties.availability_reason: salesShipments has no query spec in the Workbench BC allowlist (integrations/live_source_grammar.py) yet.

properties.name: status
properties.description: Gold shipment status (free string).

properties.name: ship_date
properties.description: The date the shipment shipped. A BC posted sales shipment records no ship status: BC posts it when the goods ship, so its postingDate is the ship date (the field Portal's drain reads and snapshots).

properties.name: freight_cost
properties.description: Outbound freight.

currency_unknown.reason: app_shipment has no currency column and the order currency is not guaranteed to apply to freight.

properties.name: total_units
properties.description: Sum of line quantities across mixed units; not a role quantity.

properties.name: customer_po
properties.description: Sage shipment PO text.

object_types.description: A shipment line per source record (BC posted shipment lines are not in the Workbench BC allowlist).
A customer invoice: Sage OE invoices (Sage era) and BC sales invoices. Portal has no invoice model and its BC sync does not post invoices under the current SOP.

properties.name: bc_number
properties.description: The BC sales invoice's document No. (a Business Central Code[20], read as PurchaseInvoice.bc_number is); invoice_number keeps it as text beside the Sage invoice No.

properties.name: external_document_number
properties.description: Portal order number at invoice time (serializer); a lead to the gold order only.

properties.name: customer_po
properties.description: The customer's PO the invoice carries (unique only per customer): Sage ponumber; BC externalDocumentNumber only on an invoice posted from a BC sales order (orderNumber set), which copies it from that order, where the Portal sent po_reference (03-PORTAL 3.3 also records the ship-only post overwriting that order's External Document No. with the shipment No.). A Portal-pushed invoice (historical, before TASK-2271) was posted directly with the Portal order number in externalDocumentNumber and no BC order, so it carries no customer PO from BC; nor does any other direct BC invoice, or one whose value equals its own order number. The served app_bc_entity_map's salesInvoice row marks a Portal push by record (ontology/schema/domains/bc_entity_map.json).

sources.note: A customer PO only on an invoice posted from a BC sales order: the Portal's direct invoice push (serializeSalesInvoice, outbox-drain syncSalesInvoice: POST salesInvoices with customerId, invoiceDate and externalDocumentNumber = order_number or SO-<id>, no order) leaves orderNumber blank and puts the Portal order number here.

properties.name: subtotal
properties.description: Invoice amount excluding tax. Blank BC currencyCode = BC local currency.

properties.name: total_amount
properties.description: Invoice total including tax.

properties.name: remaining_amount
properties.description: Open balance.
properties.availability_reason: remainingAmount is read by the Portal (bc_invoice_snapshot) but is not in the Workbench BC $select allowlist, so captures do not carry it yet.

object_types.description: A customer invoice line (Sage OE invoice detail, BC sales invoice line).

bindings.note: Read only by nested navigation from the BC invoice; documentId is the parent id.

sources.note: Inference: on a Sage invoice detail QTYSHIPPED is the quantity billed on that invoice.

properties.name: unit_price
properties.description: Unit price in the invoice currency.

per_unit_unknown.reason: sage.oe_invoice_detail serves the line's order unit (ordunit), invoice unit (invunit) and pricing unit (priceunit) and no Portal code reads its unitprice, so which of them prices the line is not grounded where they differ or one is blank.

per_unit_rules.note: Whichever of the line's three unit columns unitprice is per, when all three hold one unit after the Portal spelling fold (Sage pads its text; js_trim), the price is per that unit. A blank or a disagreement keeps the denominator unknown.

object_types.description: A BC sales credit memo: a posted (or draft) credit to a customer, optionally applied to one posted sales invoice. Captured from BC only; Portal and Sage serve no credit memo relation.

properties.name: applies_to_invoice_number
properties.description: invoiceNumber: the posted sales invoice the credit memo is applied to; blank when BC states none.

properties.name: applies_to_invoice_id
properties.description: invoiceId: the record id of the posted sales invoice the credit memo is applied to, as BC states it. Text, never an identifier property: it is read to tell a memo BC names an invoice for from one it does not (the nil Guid 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, or blank, meaning no invoice, which is when applies_to falls back to invoiceNumber). A plan filters on it to reach the memos whose applies_to may bind nothing.

properties.name: total_amount
properties.description: Credit total as BC states it on the credit memo (blank currencyCode = BC local currency). Whether BC signs it is unverified live: a consumer nets it by the document type, never by the sign.

object_types.description: A BC sales credit memo line.

bindings.note: Read only by nested navigation from the BC credit memo; documentId is the parent id.

properties.name: credited_quantity
properties.description: The line quantity credited, in the line's unit. Role returned: posting a credit memo Item line puts the quantity back into BC inventory (a positive item ledger entry). Only an Item line (line_type) names goods; a Charge or Account line credits money only, and its quantity is no returned goods.

properties.name: line_type
properties.description: The BC line type (Item, Account, Charge, Comment, Resource, Fixed Asset): which kind of object lineObjectNumber names; only an Item line names a BC item.

link_types.name: ordered_by
link_types.description: The order's customer, per source: gold customer_id, FM idcust, Sage customer (IDCUST), BC customerNumber.

link_types.name: same_record_as
link_types.description: Records of one business order in different systems (gold <-> FM OE, Sage OE, BC). Verified only on stored keys; number equality is a lead.

link_types.name: line_of
link_types.description: A line belongs to its order header in the same system.

link_types.name: for_item
link_types.description: The item ordered on a line, per source (gold product_id, Sage item No., BC item No.).

link_types.name: references_customer_po
link_types.description: The customer PO reference carried by an order record. Whether the text is a PO at all is decided by the customer_po normalizer, never by a model.

link_types.name: ships
link_types.description: The order a shipment fulfils.

link_types.name: shipped_to
link_types.description: The customer a shipment went to, per source.

link_types.name: same_record_as
link_types.description: Gold shipment and the FM silver shipment it was copied from (ETL upserts on shipment_code).

link_types.name: line_of
link_types.description: A shipment line belongs to its shipment.

link_types.name: for_item
link_types.description: The item shipped on a line.

link_types.name: bills
link_types.description: The order an invoice bills. Sage and BC links are within one system; the BC-to-gold link is the order number written into externalDocumentNumber, a lead only; Portal also tries the order's earlier numbers (fmOeNumber, erpCode), each a lead, and the customer's PO (po_reference, which the Portal sends as the BC order's externalDocumentNumber), compared by its literal text, a lead only within the invoice's customer (identifiers.json customer_po identity_scope) and only on an invoice posted from a BC sales order (orderNumber present, the same test as SalesInvoice.customer_po): a direct invoice's externalDocumentNumber is a Portal order number, never a PO. That binding's `where` gates every pair of it, including any added later: a pair that must also hold on a direct invoice goes in its own binding. The entity-map path (verified) is SalesInvoice.posted_for_order (ontology/schema/domains/bc_entity_map.json).

link_types.name: for_shipment
link_types.description: The Portal shipment a BC sales invoice was posted for: historical (ship-invoice mode, removed by TASK-2271; BC alone raises invoices now): BC stamped the Portal shipment code into externalDocumentNumber of invoices made then. A text lead only (the Portal compares trimmed text; codes are not unique across systems).

link_types.name: billed_to
link_types.description: The billed customer, per source.

link_types.name: line_of
link_types.description: An invoice line belongs to its invoice.

link_types.name: for_item
link_types.description: The item invoiced on a line.

link_types.name: credited_to
link_types.description: The BC customer credited.

link_types.name: applies_to
link_types.description: The posted BC sales invoice the credit memo is applied to, within one BC company: invoiceId when BC states it, else the invoiceNumber BC states instead (a fallback binding on the document No., a stored key unique within one company, where that number names exactly one invoice of the same company). BC states invoiceNumber only and leaves invoiceId blank or the nil Guid on some posted memos; without the fallback such a memo reaches no invoice and is also excluded from the applies_to_invoice_number absent filter that counts memos naming no invoice, so it would be netted nowhere and counted nowhere. None when BC states neither, and never a guess when the number names no invoice or several (unique_target).

link_types.name: line_of
link_types.description: A BC credit memo line belongs to its credit memo.

link_types.name: for_item
link_types.description: The BC item credited on a line.

link_types.name: same_record_as
link_types.description: One sales invoice in Sage and BC (a migrated or re-keyed invoice): invoice and order numbers, customer number, customer PO, date and total in one currency scored by ontology/identity_scoring.py (invoice). Reviewed only: no stored key joins them.

event_types.description: Sage order date (business date of a Sage-era order).
Gold row created (includes ETL and bridge inserts; not a business date).
Customer required date on the gold order.
Customer required date on the FM order entry.
Gold status changed between two captures; the true time lies in that window.
Gold shipment status changed between two captures.
BC posting date of the credit memo.

allowlist.public.app_sales_order.note: public.app_sales_order is served (domain orders) with the columns bound here.

allowlist.public.order_entry.note: FM public.order_entry is served: custpocode, datepo, datereq, erpcode, id, idcust, reference, status.

allowlist.public.order_entry_item.note: FM public.order_entry_item is served: id, idoe, idfp, idbulk, qty, status_c (no unit column).

allowlist.sage.oe_invoice_detail.note: sage.oe_invoice_detail is served (_sage_pk, invuniq, item, qtyshipped, invunit, unitprice).

allowlist.sage.oe_invoice_header.note: sage.oe_invoice_header is served (invuniq, invnumber, ordnumber, invdate, ponumber, invnet, inhomecurr/insourcurr).

allowlist.sage.oe_order_detail.note: sage.oe_order_detail is served (_sage_pk, orduniq, item, qtyordered, qtyshipped, ordunit, unitprice).

allowlist.sage.oe_order_header.note: sage.oe_order_header is served (orduniq, ordnumber, customer, ponumber, orddate, expdate, ordtotal, orsourcurr).

allowlist.sage.oe_shipment_detail.note: sage.oe_shipment_detail is served (_sage_pk, shiuniq, item, qtyshipped, ordunit).

allowlist.sage.oe_shipment_header.note: sage.oe_shipment_header is served (shiuniq, orduniq, ordnumber, shinumber, shidate, ponumber).

allowlist.silver.shipments.note: silver.shipments is served (FM shipments view; no since column).

context.critique.r1.note: Authority by era: FM/Sage bronze outranks the gold ETL copy; BC is authority for posted documents and money; gold_native_staging is never authority until a human confirms it (Q1).

context.critique.r15.note: BC company/book is a dimension of every BC-sourced object.

context.live_sources.note: BC Production, GET only; companies My Company, PLX Consol, PLX Distribution.

context.ontology_design.c1.note: Object/link catalogue for orders and purchasing (C.1, C.2) and the O2C/P2P event table (C.3).

context.portal.3.10.note: Shipment model, numbering, quantities and served relations.

context.portal.3.11.note: No Prisma sales-invoice model; Sage oe_invoice_* served; BC sync does not post invoices under the current SOP.

context.portal.3.2.note: SalesOrder/line model, customFields keys, number series, FM and Sage bridges, BC sales-order payload.

context.portal.3.3.note: Every field that can hold the customer's PO; no uniqueness or normalization beyond trim.

context.portal.3.4.note: Order identity: canonical key gold order_number; resolvers by order_number, po_reference, fmId, BC invoice.

context.portal.4.5.note: Line UOMs are free strings with no conversion; receiving converts kg to purchase UoM.

context.portal.4.8.note: FM order quantities are pieces; FM link-table quantities are not read by Portal.

context.portal.6.note: Reporting API traps: money/quantities are float-formatted strings; app_*.updated_at bumped by ETL; FM ids >= 900000 Portal-minted; po_reference mixes real POs and FM reference text.

live.portal_relation_keys.note: Live reporting API check 2026-09-30: key per relation (id for app_*/FM/silver; orduniq, shiuniq, invuniq, porhseq, rcphseq, _sage_pk for Sage).

portal.align_so_number_to_bc.note: After drain, order_number is rewritten to the BC document No.; custom_fields gets fmOeNumber, renumberedTo = BC No., renumberSource 'bc-drain-align'.

portal.bc_company_pins.note: BC books: BcBookKey manufacturing | distribution | consol, matched by company GUID / expectedNames (My Company / PLX Manufacturing, PLX Distribution, PLX Consol). Lineage bc_<book>; the consol book holds consolidation copies and is never authority.

portal.bc_drain_sales_shipments.note: Portal reads BC salesShipments by $filter orderNumber eq '<BC SO No.>' (ship-only post only since TASK-2271; the line range is at b46934a).

portal.bc_serialize_sales_invoice.note: HISTORICAL (before TASK-2271; produceSalesInvoices now throws, BC alone raises invoices): BC sales invoice payload: externalDocumentNumber = order_number (<=35 chars), invoiceDate = order_date.

portal.bc_serialize_sales_order.note: BC sales order payload: orderDate = order_date, orderNumber = order_number, externalDocumentNumber = po_reference (<=35 chars).

portal.bc_transaction_currency.note: bcTransactionCurrency: CAD (and empty) is sent as no currencyCode, i.e. BC local currency; other codes are sent upper-case.

portal.catalog_facts.sage_keys.note: Catalog facts: Sage header primary keys orduniq/shiuniq/invuniq/porhseq/rcphseq; detail rows unique on _sage_pk.

portal.ensure_fm_oe_from_sales_order.note: Gold SO -> FM OE: inserts FM order_entry with erpcode = order_number and custpocode = po_reference ?? order_number, then sets customFields {fmId, erpCode, source 'gold-so-bridge'}.

portal.ensure_sales_order_from_fm_oe.note: FM OE -> gold SO: creates SO with poReference = custpocode and customFields {fmId, erpCode, source 'fm-oe-ensure'}; on link to an existing Portal SO it stamps fmId and fills an empty poReference/requiredDate, without changing source; orderDate is not set (defaults to now()).

portal.etl_sage_make_prefix.note: MAKE orders use sageKeyPrefix 'MAKE:', so custom_fields.sageOrdUniq is not always the raw orduniq; sageSourceOrdUniq is.

portal.etl_sage_open_orders.note: Sage ETL stamps customFields {sageOrdUniq (prefixed 'MAKE:' for MAKE orders), sageSourceOrdUniq = raw orduniq, sageOrdNumber, source 'sage.oe_order_header'} and sets po_reference = COALESCE(sage ponumber, po_reference).

portal.is_sage_backed_sales_order.note: Sage-backed gold SO: sageOrdUniq | sageSourceOrdUniq | customFields.source == 'sage.oe_order_header'.

portal.portal_oe_id_base.note: PORTAL_OE_ID_BASE = 900_000: FM order_entry ids >= 900000 were minted by the Portal from gold SOs.

portal.resolve_order_by_number.note: resolveOrderByNumber: exact order_number, else exact po_reference (case-sensitive, untrimmed column).

portal.resolve_order_from_bc_invoice.note: resolveOrderFromBcInvoiceId: app_bc_entity_map (not served) first, else bc_invoice_snapshot.external_document_number -> resolveOrderByNumber.

portal.sales_order_statuses.note: Gold SO status vocabulary DRAFT, CONFIRMED, IN_PRODUCTION, READY, READY_TO_SHIP, PARTIALLY_SHIPPED, SHIPPED, COMPLETE, CANCELLED, plus legacy 'Open'; the column is a free string.

prisma.sales_order.note: model SalesOrder @@map("app_sales_order"): orderNumber unique (order_number), customerId, orderDate default now(), requiredDate, status free String, totalAmount Float, currency default CAD, poReference, customFields Json.

prisma.sales_order_line.note: model SalesOrderLine @@map("app_sales_order_line"): salesOrderId FK, productId FK, quantity Float, unitPrice, uom free String, totalPrice, lineSource STOCK|MAKE.

prisma.shipment.note: model Shipment @@map("app_shipment"): shipmentNumber unique (shipment_code), salesOrderId FK optional, customerId, status String, shipDate, deliveryDate, carrier, trackingNumber, freightCost, totalQuantity (total_units).

prisma.shipment_line.note: model ShipmentLine @@map("app_shipment_line"): shipmentId FK, productId FK, quantity, uom, lotNumber, lotId; orderRef/orderLineRef carry FM ids but are not served.

workbench.bc_query_specs.note: BC_QUERY_SPECS: selectable fields per BC entity set (salesOrders, salesInvoices, salesCreditMemos, purchaseOrders, purchaseReceipts, purchaseInvoices and their lines); BC_DOCUMENT_LINES reads lines only by nested navigation from the header id.

workbench.link_contract.bc_invoice_order.note: bc-invoice-to-portal-order-by-doc-number: the same order-number lead from the BC invoice snapshot; Portal's fallback after the entity map.

workbench.bc_same_company_scope.note: Both ends are BC captures: compare only within one BC company (bc_<book> equal on both ends). BC numbers are unique per company only; masters synced to several books and consolidation copies reuse them (SO vs DSO series: outbox-drain.ts:880-890 @b46934a). Machine-readable today as ontology.schema.link_company_scope / CompiledSchema.company_scope.

portal.bc_finance_match_keys.note: Every string a BC sales invoice's externalDocumentNumber may carry for one order: order_number, custom_fields erpCode / fmOeNumber / renumberedTo (the numbers before and after BC renumbering), the order's app_shipment.shipment_code (invoices made in ship-invoice mode, before TASK-2271, carry the Portal shipment code), and entity-map salesInvoice bc_number. Each is a lookup needle, not a stored key. Unchanged at c3ffda3.

portal.bc_finance_invoice_match.note: Invoices match when TRIM(external_document_number) equals a needle exactly (case-sensitive) or their number is an entity-map invoice number; several invoices may match one order. Unchanged at c3ffda3.

workbench.bc_line_amount_excl_tax.note: BC API v2.0 salesOrderLine amountExcludingTax (Edm.Decimal): the line amount after the line discount, excluding tax, in the order header's currency (blank currencyCode: the company's local currency). It is before the order's invoice discount allocation (invoiceDiscountAllocation), as salesInvoiceLine amountExcludingTax is (SalesInvoiceLine.amount_excluding_tax). The BC capture reads every line field (integrations/bc_read.py). Live-unverified.

workbench.bc_line_price_uom.note: BC_QUERY_SPECS serves unitOfMeasureCode on every BC document line next to its quantity and its unitPrice/directUnitCost/unitCost. Business Central prices a document line per the line's Unit of Measure Code (the line's quantity is counted in the same code), so the line's code is the price's denominator. The Portal never folds its BC codes back, so the unit fold (ontology/units.py) folds one only where the Portal's own table spells it: PCS is the Portal alias pcs (ea) and CSE the option cse, so a BC PCS price and a Portal ea price share a denominator, while GR stays gr, never g.

portal.sales_order_line_price_per_uom.note: Portal-native sales order lines: totalPrice = unitPrice x quantity with the line's own uom, so unit_price is per the line's uom and total_price is the line amount.

portal.sage_unitprice_per_ordunit.note: Sage O/E line UNITPRICE is per the line's order unit (ordunit): a CSE-unit price is divided by units per case to get a per-each price.

portal.sage_so_lines_product_uom.note: Sage open orders -> gold lines: unit_price is the Sage line unitprice (per the Sage ordunit) but uom is the gold product's uom (p.uom, default 'ea'), and quantity/total are the open (ordered - shipped) quantity and its amount.

portal.fm_oe_lines_price_list_uom.note: FM O/E -> gold lines: uom is the FM line uom, else the product uom, else a guessed 'ea'/'kg'; unit_price is a Sage price-list price for the item (or the existing line's), never stated per that uom.

workbench.bc_sales_credit_memos.note: BC_QUERY_SPECS salesCreditMemos / salesCreditMemoLines: field names from the BC API v2.0 salesCreditMemo and salesCreditMemoLine resources (MicrosoftDocs dynamics365smb-devitpro-pb api-reference/v2.0); invoiceId / invoiceNumber name the invoice the credit memo is applied to. Captured by integrations.bc_read.BcCapture (lines by nested navigation); unverified live until live check ``bc.capture_full`` records the units complete.

workbench.bc_posted_order_identity.note: BC API v2.0 salesOrders lists open orders only: BC deletes a sales order once it is fully shipped and invoiced, and its posted salesInvoices and salesShipments keep the number (orderNumber). The order is therefore one identity per company and number: the salesOrders record while BC serves it (or a capture still holds it), else the first-recorded posted document naming it (projector stands_for, ontology/project.py).

workbench.bc_sales_prices_include_tax.note: BC API v2.0 salesOrder / salesInvoice / salesCreditMemo pricesIncludeTax (Edm.Boolean, nullable; pinned $metadata) states whether the document's line prices include tax, as on the purchase documents. The BC capture reads every header field (integrations/bc_read.py). A line's unitPrice reads it through its header: true is incl_tax, false excl_tax, null or absent unknown (tax_basis_unresolved). Live-unverified.

workbench.bc_company_local_currency.note: BC API v2.0 companyInformation.currencyCode (pinned $metadata; the generated type RelBcCompanyInformation, captured once per company): the company's local currency (LCY) code. A BC document whose currencyCode is blank is in that local currency: the Portal sends CAD and an empty currency as no currencyCode (bcTransactionCurrency, portal.bc_transaction_currency). The projector reads it on the one companyInformation record of the document's company (lineage bc_<book>); without that capture the currency stays unresolved (currency_unknown). Live-unverified until a live read shows a blank-currency document beside its company's companyInformation.

workbench.customer_po_identity_scope.note: customer_po identity_scope (party customer) and carrier sales_order_po_reference_to_bc_sales_order: the Portal sends po_reference as the BC order's externalDocumentNumber (serializers.ts:1157-1158) and resolves a BC invoice's order by order number, else by PO within the invoice's customer (order-identity.ts resolveOrderFromBcInvoiceId -> resolveOrderByNumber with resolvePortalCustomerIdFromBc; no customer, no PO step).

portal.quote_convert.note: quotes evidence portal.quote_convert (plx-customer-portal@790256ca43:portal/src/lib/sales-order/convert.ts:104-176, stampQuoteConverted): convertAcceptedQuote locks the ACCEPTED quote FOR UPDATE, creates the sales order (customFields.sourceQuoteId/Number) and stamps the quote's customFields.convertedSalesOrderId/Number/convertedAt in the same transaction. Cited through the quotes domain, whose Portal pin is that commit.

wb.identity_scoring.note: Weighted identity candidates (Fellegi-Sunter: blocking, field comparison levels, m/u from verified and reviewed pairs) offered for a person's review; a link exists only once plx.review records the decision, projected by ontology/reviews.py link_step as reviewed.

workbench.sage_invoice_units_agree.note: Projector._per_unit_rule (agreeing): a Sage O/E invoice line's unitprice is per one of the line's unit columns (the Portal prices the Sage order line per ordunit, portal.sage_unitprice_per_ordunit; Sage invoice lines also serve invunit and priceunit, generated/meta/portal_catalog.json). When the three agree after ontology/units.py unit_token the denominator is that unit whichever column prices it; otherwise it stays unknown (price_denominator_unknown). Live-unverified until live check ``ontology.money_units`` records a result.
